title: Pala artists: selected lives, works and cultural continuity
scope: 20 selected practitioners; not a statewide census, fame ranking, complete biography set or current booking directory.

artists.name: Jagannath Behera
artists.recognition: Sangeet Natak Akademi Award 2009 for Pala; citation also records state award 2007.
artists.work: Quoted literary classics across Odia, Bengali, Hindi, Sanskrit and English; citation records two books and poetry without book titles.
artists.cultural_continuity: Combined performance, writing and cultural organisation; citation records past leadership of All Orissa Pala Gayak Parishad and association with Jogi Mahapurusha Sanskrit Vidyalaya.
artists.continuity_evidence: Direct institutional account; offices are historical citation statements.
artists.limits: Birth year conflict: citation 1926, Odisha Sambad 2018 profile 1925. No resolved birth date, current office or living-status assertion.

artists.name: Laxmidhar Rout
artists.recognition: Sangeet Natak Akademi Award 2016, Pala; PIB uses Laxmidhar Raut.
artists.work: Authored Udaharana Sataka, according to citation. A 16 September 2024 report credits his Odia verse translation of Adhyatma Ramayana, using ragas and poetic ornament.
artists.cultural_continuity: Citation explicitly credits training younger students and teaching through Pala Pratishthan, Shree Jagannath Pala Research Foundation and Shree Nilachala Nikhila Utkala Pala Parishad, Kendrapara.
artists.continuity_evidence: Direct institutional teaching evidence; later publication is a secondary report.
artists.evidence_period: 2016 citation; January 2018 programme; September 2024 book report

reading_or_listening.title: Pala prashikshana / akhada
reading_or_listening.inspection: Existing UKS catalogue title only; not a full teaching-session analysis.

artists.limits: Distinct from Laxman Charan Rout. No current office or student count established; no ISBN/publisher or full book inspection.

artists.name: Ghanashyam Nayak
artists.recognition: Remembered as Gayak Bhushan in a 2019 profile.
artists.work: Combined dancing, Dakhini, Padi, Athatali, Nadia Kirtan and mandira playing; wrote Pala poetry, bhajans and jananas.
artists.cultural_continuity: Profile describes disciples and continued performance of his compositions by later singers.
artists.continuity_evidence: Secondary historical account, not a verified pupil census.
artists.limits: Profile reports death in 1986. Named composition editions and pupil list remain unverified; no present activity implied.

artists.name: Arjun Dash
artists.recognition: Known as Gayak Bani Bibhushan; profile attributes that title to Ravenshaw College in 1975.
artists.work: Repertoire included Harishchandra, Kumarasambhava, Naishadha, Subhadra Parinaya and Nimai Sannyasa; noted for shringara and karuna expression.
artists.cultural_continuity: Profile describes training students and participating in Badi Pala with several senior exponents.
artists.continuity_evidence: Dated secondary retrospective; named students still needed.
artists.limits: Profile reports death 25 August 2012. State award year and pupil identities not independently established.

artists.name: Abhaya Charan Swain
artists.recognition: Sahityacharya and Sanskrit teacher profiled as a distinguished Pala exponent.
artists.work: Known for Sanskrit kavya and drama interpretation, dramatic delivery and psychological reading of characters. Profile recalls a student performance drawn from Kalidasa’s Meghaduta.
artists.cultural_continuity: Connected formal Sanskrit learning with accessible performed interpretation.
artists.continuity_evidence: Interpretation of documented practice; no measured audience learning outcome.
artists.limits: Reported retired in that profile. Do not describe as presently touring. No independently verified national award claimed.

artists.name: Amareswar Das / Amar Das
artists.recognition: Remembered as Malika Samrat in a 2018 retrospective.
artists.work: Associated with Malika and Panchasakha literature and quick responses in Badi Pala.
artists.cultural_continuity: Agadhu Beura’s separate profile identifies him as the guru from whom Beura received the chamara.
artists.continuity_evidence: Two profiles from one publisher family; a reported transmission link, not independent institutional corroboration.
artists.limits: Profile reports death in April 2018. Claim that he was the first to introduce Malika into Pala is not adopted; prophecy is literary/religious belief, not verified prediction.

artists.name: Prahallad Sahoo
artists.recognition: Profiled as Gayak Samrat in September 2018; honorific, not a national award label.
artists.work: Reported repertoire includes Raghuvamsha, Shishupala Vadha, Rukmini Parinaya and Naishadha Charita; draws on Odia, Sanskrit and Hindi poets.
artists.cultural_continuity: Profile describes learning as a bayak with Udayanath Dash, then receiving his books and performance implements.
artists.continuity_evidence: Secondary account of apprenticeship and material transmission.
artists.limits: No current touring, performance-night totals or pupil count adopted. Foundation biography names Biswanath Pattajoshi; this may describe another teacher, not an exclusive lineage.

artists.name: Raghunath Nathsharma
artists.recognition: Profile celebrates his Odissi, chhanda and champu singing.
artists.work: Career connected musical performance with Sanskrit learning; profile reports performances in Odisha and neighbouring states.
artists.cultural_continuity: Even after retiring from stage performance, other singers reportedly visited him to learn.
artists.continuity_evidence: Directly reported teaching continuation in the dated profile.
artists.limits: Retirement/visits are 2020 statements, not verified current arrangements. No national recognition inferred.

artists.name: Gangadhar Puhan / Puhana
artists.recognition: Profiled as Gayak Sourav/Sourabh in May 2021.
artists.work: Known for chhanda, champu, chaupadi and Odissi; profile names Bhanja literature and Udayanath Rathsharma’s kavya and drama.
artists.cultural_continuity: Keeps literary song forms in the performance repertoire; training account connects several specialised teachers.
artists.continuity_evidence: Repertoire continuity is an interpretation of reported practice, not measured preservation impact.
artists.limits: No current performance calendar or formal national award established.

artists.name: Nityananda Barik
artists.recognition: Profiled as Gayak Guru and a Sanskrit teacher.
artists.work: Linked Sanskrit study and teaching with Pala akhada and performance.
artists.cultural_continuity: 2020 profile reports free tuition after school retirement. Chandrasekhar Padhi’s profile describes Barik’s Sanskrit teaching and akhada in Padhi’s childhood surroundings.
artists.continuity_evidence: Dated reported teaching; general tuition is not a verified Pala conservatory.
artists.limits: Do not turn school/university tuition into a count of trained Pala artists. Current teaching availability unknown.

artists.name: Agadhu Beura
artists.recognition: Profiled as Gayak Mani, with a public performance and organising career.
artists.work: Worked in Baishnab Pani’s gitinatya as actor/director before and alongside Pala; profile connects his family to three generations of Pala.
artists.cultural_continuity: 2020 profile reports nine years as Cuttack district Pala council secretary and formation of Sri Sri Dhabaleswar Pala Gayak Parishad across five blocks.
artists.continuity_evidence: Secondary organisational biography; dated role, no legal/current office claim.
artists.limits: Exact council registration, term dates and present officers unknown. No inference of the same institution as UKS TV or CT13T004.

artists.name: Chandrasekhar Padhi
artists.recognition: 2020 profile identifies an established younger Pala performer from the Soro area of Balasore.
artists.work: Developed Sanskrit-based performance and Badi Pala; profile describes inspiration from Govinda Padhi’s Panchama Baradi singing.
artists.cultural_continuity: His account documents the passage from a bayak’s household and Sanskrit lessons to akhada and a performing career.
artists.continuity_evidence: Reported apprenticeship example, not evidence of his own current school.
artists.limits: No annual performance count, current age label or national award adopted.

artists.name: Santilata Sahu
artists.recognition: Named Pala participant, Odisha Sangeet Natak Akademi festival, Rabindra Mandap; government roster associates Jagatsinghpur.
artists.work: Hanuman’s meditation in Dwapara Yuga.
artists.cultural_continuity: Led a named Pala troupe on a state festival stage.
artists.continuity_evidence: Programme participation is direct government evidence; repertoire is a contemporary arts report. Continuity beyond this dated event is unmeasured.
artists.limits: Current activity, teaching, full biography and media rights remain unknown. No national award inferred from festival selection.

artists.name: Laxman Charan Rout
artists.recognition: Named Pala participant, Odisha Sangeet Natak Akademi festival, Rabindra Mandap; government roster associates Bhadrak.
artists.work: Mahadani Ajigarta, linked in the report to Bhimsen Vedapathi’s Ajigarttopakhyana.
artists.cultural_continuity: Chandrasekhar Padhi’s profile also names Rout as a later guru.
artists.continuity_evidence: Programme participation is direct government evidence; repertoire is a contemporary arts report. Continuity beyond this dated event is unmeasured.

artists.cultural_continuity: Kept epic exposition on the state festival stage.

artists.name: Sachidananda Dash
artists.recognition: Public professional profile and named UKS TV performer; dated 2026 Chaiti Parba report.
artists.work: UKS TV credits Guru Dakhina and the Juga Purusha playlist; 16 April 2026 closing report credits Badi Pala with Dhiren Mohanty.
artists.cultural_continuity: Online catalogue extends access beyond an individual performance occasion.
artists.continuity_evidence: Recording credits and metadata reused from the saved 19 October network audit; no measured reach/learning claim.

conflicts.subject: agadhu-beura
conflicts.description: Profile says born 1955 yet already directed 37 plays before Pala initiation 1967. These detailed youth counts/dates are not adopted without stronger evidence.

open_questions: Named bayak and palia biographies: this set is lead-singer-heavy, not a complete troupe credit.
Current teaching/student outcomes and dated activity for women performers; do not infer inactivity from missing records.
Work editions, publisher/ISBN and original authorship for Udaharana Sataka and Adhyatma Ramayana translation.
Markandeya Bahinipati, Kashinath Jena, Niranjan Kar and women beyond the 2012 roster need work-level biographies; SJPRF documentary notices are leads.
Recording occasion, full episode literary attribution and permissions; no downloaded or republished audio/video.
